name: toolkit
description: Small, focused Claude Code plugins for running file-based agent teams: onboarding an agent to a coordinator's inbox and outbox, and read-only reviewer subagents.

plugins.name: agent-onboarding
plugins.description: Charter template, a /start-work skill and an .agent/ inbox-outbox setup for an agent that takes tasks from a coordinator agent.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Read-only fact-checker and editorial-reviewer subagents that return PASS, FAIL or ESCALATE.
